title: Check AUV/AGV Status Details in the “Overall System AGV Status” Pop-up
summary: Open the AUV/AGV status pop-up and use the page titled “Overall System AGV Status” to view the system’s current overall AGV/AUV status details.
when_to_use: When you need to quickly view the current overall AGV/AUV status details from the AUV status pop-up page titled “Overall System AGV Status.”
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the AUV/AGV status pop-up and read the “Overall System AGV Status” page to report the current overall AGV/AUV status details.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the OptiSweep/HMI screen where the AUV status pop-up appears
The “Overall System AGV Status” pop-up page

access_required: OptiSweep/HMI access to open the AUV status pop-up

visual_references.description: Frame showing the AUV status pop-up with the page title “Overall System AGV Status” and the statement that it shows the current status.

steps.title: Locate and open the AUV status pop-up
steps.purpose: Get to the AUV/AGV status pop-up so you can view the current overall AGV/AUV status details.
steps.instruction: Open the AUV status pop-up on the OptiSweep/HMI.
steps.expected_result: The AUV status pop-up is open and you can see the page titled “Overall System AGV Status.”
steps.healthy_condition: The pop-up is visible (not blank) and the page title area is present.
steps.failure_condition: The pop-up does not appear, or the page title “Overall System AGV Status” is not shown.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the pop-up does not appear or the page title “Overall System AGV Status” is not shown, stop and escalate to higher support (L2/L3).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: "AUV status. Just another pop up that shows you in details again..."
OCR: "Overall System AGV Status" and "This page will show the current status"

steps.title: Confirm the page title reads “Overall System AGV Status”
steps.purpose: Ensure you are viewing the correct pop-up page before interpreting status details.
steps.instruction: On the pop-up page, confirm the header/title reads “Overall System AGV Status.”
steps.expected_result: The header/title “Overall System AGV Status” is visible on the pop-up page.
steps.healthy_condition: The title text “Overall System AGV Status” is clearly readable in the pop-up header area.
steps.failure_condition: The title “Overall System AGV Status” is missing or different from what is expected.

actions.label: Verify header/title
actions.exact_action: Confirm the header/title reads “Overall System AGV Status”

stop_or_escalate_if: If the page title “Overall System AGV Status” is not shown, stop and escalate to higher support (L2/L3).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/artifact text includes: "Overall System AGV Status"

steps.title: Verify the page is presenting current status details
steps.purpose: Confirm the pop-up is showing live/current status information (not an outdated or non-status view).
steps.instruction: Verify the page indicates it will show the current status (i.e., you are viewing the current status details section on the “Overall System AGV Status” page).
steps.expected_result: The pop-up page is presenting current status details for the system’s AGV/AUV status.
steps.healthy_condition: The “current status” details section is visible on the “Overall System AGV Status” page.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not show any current status details (e.g., blank or missing the status details area).

actions.label: Check current status details are shown
actions.exact_action: Verify the page is presenting “current status” details

stop_or_escalate_if: If the page is not presenting current status details, stop and escalate to higher support (L2/L3).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: "This page will show the current status"

steps.title: Use the displayed status details to determine the system’s overall AGV/AUV status
steps.purpose: Provide the current overall AGV/AUV status information to support triage and next actions.
steps.instruction: Read the displayed status details on the “Overall System AGV Status” pop-up page and report what the system’s overall AGV/AUV status currently is.
steps.expected_result: You can view and interpret the current overall AGV/AUV status details shown on the “Overall System AGV Status” pop-up.
steps.healthy_condition: The status details are visible and can be used to answer the system’s current overall AGV/AUV status.
steps.failure_condition: The status details are not visible or cannot be interpreted because the page content is missing/blank.

actions.label: Read overall status details
actions.exact_action: Use the displayed status details to answer what the system’s overall AGV/AUV status currently is

stop_or_escalate_if: If the status details are not visible or the pop-up/page title is incorrect, stop and escalate to higher support (L2/L3).

failure_conditions: Page title “Overall System AGV Status” is not shown.
